derivation: from H1730 (דּוֹד) and H3050 (יָהּ); love of Jah;

occurrences.text: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavah of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, Because thou hast joined thyself with Ahaziah, the Lord hath broken thy works. And the ships were broken, that they were not able to go to Tarshish.
